fabrics every elegant
woman should know

cashmere

the soft undercoat of goats
from the kashmir mountains.

silk

unwound from the cocoon
of the silkworm.

linen

woven from flax: one of
the oldest fabrics on earth.

merino

the finest wool, soft
enough for bare skin.

harris tweed

still handwoven in the
outer hebrides.

velvet

once woven only from silk,
for royalty.

one thing learned a day beats
an hour of scrolling.
